svg.aria-label: Стек / Stack — Languages: Python, PHP, TypeScript, JavaScript, Dart, Go, SQL, C++ (WinAPI), Bash, PowerShell. Backend: FastAPI, Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, WebSocket. Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JS, jQuery, Vue, Nuxt, MapLibre GL, Leaflet, esbuild. Mobile: Flutter, Riverpod, Dio, go_router, flutter_map, Firebase (FCM), Bluetooth LE, Android, iOS. Databases: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Redis, SQLite. Integrations: discord.js, DisTube, Telegram Bot API, sherpa-onnx (speech-to-text), IoT: TCP / BLE. Infra: Linux, systemd, Nginx, Apache, Caddy, Docker, OSPanel, aaPanel, Windows. Testing: pytest, unittest, node:test, flutter_test.
